# Karen Diaz — former Plant Manager, Greenville

> **DEPARTED 2026-06-05.** Karen no longer works at Brandt Industrial. She left to run operations
> at a larger equipment maker. **Do not route current Greenville work to her.** The Greenville
> plant-manager seat is **open**; COO [Sandra Kim](sandra-kim.md) is covering it, and the
> backfill is an open [commitment](../commitments.md).

- **Former role:** ran the **Greenville, SC** HPU plant (~380 people) 2021–2026.
- **Left behind:** the [HydraForce capacity expansion](../projects/hydraforce-capacity-expansion.md)
  mid-flight; VP Ops [Terrence Boyd](terrence-boyd.md) picked it up.
- **Relationship now:** amicable; would take a reference call. Not a current stakeholder.

## Why this file still exists
- Historical context and a guardrail: work touching Greenville from June 2026 on is **not** hers.
